issues.quote: The regulator on the wall had stopped. I thought, God forgive me, that it had stopped with its master.
issues.fact: The fact sheet says nothing about the atelier regulator or any stopped clock.
issues.misreading: A solver could treat the stopped regulator as a time-of-death marker and read it as fixing when Aurèle died, which the sheet does not give.

issues.quote: He had his repeater in his hand. He was so proud of that watch.
issues.fact: The fact sheet says nothing about a repeater watch in Aurèle's hand.
issues.misreading: A solver could take the repeater as a time source that records a reading at the death, adding a clock the sheet never mentions.

issues.quote: A man struck like that would have known very little about it. It would have been very quick.
issues.fact: The fact sheet says nothing about how long the blow or death took.
issues.misreading: 'Very quick' could be read as a hint about how long the killing took, which bears on the timing puzzle without any sheet support.
